summary: Single-write setter: sets the byte at the memory location (base - 144) to the constant 1. The base pointer arrives in a caller register (__usercall, a1@<ebp>); the byte at offset -144 relative to it is treated as a boolean flag that this function raises.

operations.description: Write the constant 1 as a byte to the address (a1 - 144), where a1 is the caller-supplied base pointer; the legacy ABI lead names this routine SetByteFlag.

unresolved: The base pointer a1 (@<ebp>) and the structure it points into are unknown; the byte at offset -144 is not a named field in any available evidence.
Semantic meaning of the flag (the state it toggles) and the identity of the owning object depend on caller context, which is absent from this packet.
